I replied to Marcus in his #north-team thread: the main contact is Thea Ramaswell, Director of Yard Operations at Quarrendon Freight Lines.

- **Source:** Dana posted in #north-team on Aug 20, 2025 that Thea had flagged duplicate arrivals on door 6 on the morning shift. Marcus is in that channel. The public North cheat sheet also lists Thea as the main contact.
- **What caused it:** the same trailer showed up twice because the driver checked in at the kiosk and dispatch then added him manually. I included that in the reply.
- **Ownership:** I mentioned that Dana has owned the account since June 2025, so he should check with her for anything newer.

None of this is a finance figure, so nothing needed approval.
